_metadata.description: Emergency resources for the Student Wellbeing Triage System.
_metadata.admin_note: All contacts verified for live higher-education student support.
_metadata.reviewed_by: University Student Wellbeing & Clinical Safety Team

global.disclaimer: This system provides automated initial triage support only. It does not diagnose mental health conditions, guarantee crisis detection, or replace professional clinical assessment. If you are in immediate danger, please call your local emergency services immediately.
global.crisis_message: You are not alone. Immediate help is here for you. Please connect with one of the emergency contacts below — they are trained and ready to support you right now.

emergency_contacts.name: Emergency Services
emergency_contacts.description: Call immediately if you or someone else is in immediate danger or needs urgent medical attention.

emergency_contacts.name: Samaritans Crisis Line
emergency_contacts.description: Free, confidential listening support available day or night for anyone in distress.

emergency_contacts.name: Shout Crisis Text Line
emergency_contacts.description: Free, confidential 24/7 text conversation with trained crisis volunteers.

emergency_contacts.name: Student Mental Wellbeing & Rapid Response
emergency_contacts.description: Campus clinical counselors providing rapid assessment, triage, and urgent mental health support.

emergency_contacts.name: Campus Security & First Response
emergency_contacts.description: Campus Security control room for immediate on-site safety, first aid, and escort support.
emergency_contacts.admin_note: Direct radio dispatch to campus duty officers

online_resources.name: Mind Mental Health Charity
online_resources.description: Evidence-based mental health resources, coping strategies, and local community support.

online_resources.name: Student Minds UK
online_resources.description: The UK's dedicated student mental health charity with student-specific guidance.

emergency_contacts.name: Emergency Services
emergency_contacts.description: Call immediately if you or someone else is in immediate physical danger.

emergency_contacts.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
emergency_contacts.description: Free, confidential crisis counseling via call or text across the United States.

emergency_contacts.name: Crisis Text Line
emergency_contacts.description: Free, 24/7 text support with trained crisis counselors.

emergency_contacts.name: Campus Counseling & Crisis Center
emergency_contacts.description: On-campus psychologists and confidential counseling services.

online_resources.name: NAMI (National Alliance on Mental Illness)
online_resources.description: National support, education, and advocacy for mental health.
